title: Width + batch-size stack
description: Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 width win), changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (round-0 batch-size win), stacking both orthogonal wins together.
reflection: The stack works and is additive/better than either alone: val_bpb 0.982595 vs baseline 0.998671 (ASPECT_RATIO=96 alone) and 1.001440 (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18 alone at ASPECT_RATIO=64). This confirms the two mechanisms (capacity per step, step count/gradient noise) were genuinely orthogonal, not compensating for the same underlying issue as some speculated. This exact experiment was proposed by 5-6/6 agents in each of the last two rounds and never actually run until now.
